id_routing.description: Interconnect may append bits to AxID to identify the originating master; slave-side ID_WIDTH > master-side ID_WIDTH
id_routing.compliance_note: Returning ID is the WIDER value; routing strips appended bits before returning to the master

fields.topology_type: Master/slave shared bus per channel. One NAND Flash Controller drives strobes + DQ + per-target CE_n; one or more NAND Targets (LUNs grouped by CE_n) share the bus. R/B_n is open-drain device-driven and wired-OR across targets.

supported_topologies.name: Single host + single target (per channel)
supported_topologies.description: Simplest; low-end SSD or consumer USB drive.

supported_topologies.name: Single host + multi-target with per-target CE_n
supported_topologies.description: Up to 4 (or more on BGA-272 / BGA-316) targets; host selects via CE_n.

supported_topologies.name: Single host + multi-target with CE_n pin reduction
Independent Data Buses (Section 2.16)
supported_topologies.description: Two parallel DQ buses for double per-package throughput.

supported_topologies.name: Multi-channel host controller
supported_topologies.description: Parallel ONFI channels in SSD controllers.

supported_topologies.name: Matrix termination (ODT)
supported_topologies.description: NV-DDR3 multi-target with per-LUN ODT states.

master_slave_role_summary.description: Generates all strobes; issues all commands; runs training; owns ECC (raw) or offloads (EZ); implements FTL.
Decodes cmd/addr; drives data on strobes; drives R/B_n LOW during operations.

fields.interconnect_role: No protocol-layer router or bridge — flat 1-host : N-target bus per channel. Multi-target arbitration is time-domain via CE_n (or Volume Address after CE_n reduction).

ordering_guarantees.within_a_page: Bytes streamed in column order from the page register.
ordering_guarantees.across_commands: Strictly serial within a single LUN; parallel across LUNs.
ordering_guarantees.multi_plane: Multi-plane Program / Erase / Read execute concurrently within a LUN; FAIL is per-plane.
ordering_guarantees.page_cache: Page Cache Program allows pipelined next-page submission while prior-page array program in progress; FAILC reports prior.

fields.memory_vs_peripheral_regions: Hierarchical block→page→column address space. No memory-mapped peripheral region; Parameter Page / Unique ID / Status accessed via dedicated commands (ECh / EDh / 70h).

device_classification.raw_nand: Pure NAND die; host runs full ECC + FTL.
device_classification.multi_lun_target: Single CE_n drives multiple LUNs sharing a package.
